channel.description: Latest articles from CT News Junkie (ctnewsjunkie.com)

item.title: Greenwich Republican Named To Lamont's Education Funding Commission | CT News Junkie
item.description: The commission will conduct a comprehensive review of Connecticut's education funding system and issue recommendations to the governor and General Assembly. Its scope includes the state's current funding landscape, models from other states, the primary cost drivers facing school districts, and proven strategies that have delivered better outcomes for students.

item.title: Diaper Grant Program Clears Committee Vote | CT News Junkie
item.description: House Bill 5486 would provide $1 million in grant funding for a new Diaper Partnership Grant Program.

item.title: CT, 20 Other States Win Judgment Over Barring Gender-Affirming Care | CT News Junkie
item.description: According to published reports, U.S. District Judge Mustafa Kasubhai in Eugene, Oregon,ruled that a December declaration by Kennedy to bar healthcare providers that offer such gender affirming care from Medicare and Medicaid, and prohibiting the Children’s Health Insurance Program from paying for it, overstepped his authority and violated federal law.

item.title: CT Agency Picked To Lead Federal Career Training Grant Expansion | CT News Junkie
item.description: Federal bill H.R. 1 enacted an expansion of Pell Grants to include short-term, career-focused training programs. These Workforce Pell Grants offer need-based aid to low-income students for programs ranging from eight to 15 weeks and comprising 150 to 599 clock hours of instruction.

item.title: Opinion: The Case For Housing As A Public Utility | CT News Junkie
item.description: Peter Fousek, of the CT Tenants Union, says Connecticut should treat housing through large-scale landlords like a public utility.

item.title: Many ACA Customers Are Paying Higher Premiums. Most Blame Trump And Republicans, Poll Finds. | CT News Junkie
item.description: Most people who get their health coverage through the Affordable Care Act say they face sharply higher costs, with many worried they will have to pare back other expenses to cover them, according to a poll released Thursday. Some are uncertain whether they will be able to continue paying their premiums all year.

item.title: CT Senator Requests Protection For Sailors In Persian Gulf After Report From Stranded State Mariner | CT News Junkie
item.description: Blumenthal, a member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, wrote to Admiral Brad Cooper, commander of the U.S. Central Command, raising concerns about crew safety about such vessels, which he said are reportedly rationing water and provisions while operating under sustained psychological and operational stress due to the United States and Israel’s war against Iran.

item.title: Should CT Consider Unused Gift Cards Abandoned Property? | CT News Junkie
item.description: Current state law prohibits expiration dates on most gift cards sold in Connecticut and businesses must provide a cash refund upon consumer request for any balance less than $5 after a purchase is made.

item.title: CT Investigating After Another Incarcerated Person Dies In Custody | CT News Junkie
item.description: Whyte is the fifth incarcerated person to die in state custody since February whose death is considered untimely or is under investigation.

item.title: CT Bills Targeting ICE, Establishing Safe Zones Likely To Advance From Committee | CT News Junkie
item.description: Senate Bill 397, An Act Concerning Democracy and Government Accountability, and Senate Bill 91, An Act Concerning the Investigative Authority of the Inspector General and Establishing Protected Areas, are attempts to increase accountability of federal agents operating in Connecticut.

item.title: Report: CT Youth Among Country's Safest From Alcohol-Related Deaths | CT News Junkie
item.description: In this study every state got an alcohol score, using two metrics and weighted 80% — 20% for the fatalities per 100,000. Connecticut scored a 19.62 out of 100, good for sixth on the list between New Hampshire (18.34) and Rhode Island (19.7).

item.title: Missing Ballistic Vests, Failure To Test Disaster Plan Highlighted In Judicial Branch Audit | CT News Junkie
item.description: State auditors looked at the fiscal years ending June 30, 2023, and 2024 and noted seven deficiencies in the department. Auditors recommended strengthening internal controls as a result of the findings.

item.title: CT Steps Up Opioid Overdose Prevention Efforts | CT News Junkie
item.description: On Tuesday morning, state officials from the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection joined officials from the Connecticut National Guard Counterdrug Program, Connecticut State Police and the Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services to highlight efforts to increase the availability of naloxone, an opioid antagonist used to reverse drug effects and potentially save the life of someone who has overdosed.

item.title: Rising Health Costs Push Some Middle-Aged Adults To Skip The Doc Until Medicare | CT News Junkie
item.description: Without enhanced federal subsidies, some people who are on Affordable Care Act plans nearing retirement age are delaying care until they qualify for Medicare. This puts their health at risk and potentially shifts costs to taxpayers as their bills get bigger because they delayed treatment.

item.title: Bill Targeting 'Vexatious' Info Requesters Advances | CT News Junkie
item.description: Senate Bill 466, An Act Concerning Vexatious Requesters Under the Freedom of Information Act, would take away someone’s right to make FOI requests if they abuse that right.
